card.title: 388th INDEPENDENT
card.text: Destruction: The enemy draws a card.
card.flavorText: The 388th Independent infantry battalion was part of the 117th Infantry division of the Imperial Japanese Army. In 1945, the 117th Division was transferred to the Kwantung Army. It saw combat during the Soviet invasion of Manchuria and kept fighting even after the official surrender of Japan. The Japanese forces had a formidable reputation and managed to put up strong resistance in some areas. But overall they proved to be no match against the Soviet forces who were battle-hardened veterans from the European theater, and had far superior tanks and equipment.
